title: Undoing a second import file leaves a member owing money they never owed
what: When a second import file adds payments to a plan that an earlier import made, it raises that plan's price to match. Undo this import then removes the second file's receipts but keeps the raised price. The member's page and the dues list then show money owed equal to the removed receipts, though the member owes nothing.
expected: Undoing an import puts every plan price it changed back to what it was, so dues after the undo match dues before the import.
how_often: whenever an owner imports a payments list in two files and undoes the second
fix_line: Keep the old price when an import raises it, and restore it on undo

title: Putting a gym online can leave out the last check-in or payment saved while it copies
what: Put your gym online copies the browser's records up, then looks again and copies again if anything changed, at most three times. If a save lands during the third copy (for example a check-in from a second tab), that save is never sent, and the panel then works only from the online copy, so it is missing there.
expected: Every record saved in the browser before the switch arrives online, or the switch waits until nothing new is saved.
how_often: rarely (only when records are saved while the gym is being put online)
fix_line: After the last copy, send anything still new, or pause saving while copying
